hooks.name: Coding Standards Check
hooks.description: After a TypeScript source file is saved, scans it for BeatNote coding-standard violations.

action.prompt: A source file under src/ was just saved. Quickly scan it against the BeatNote coding standards in .kiro/steering/coding-standards.md. Check specifically for: (1) hardcoded hex colour values that should use tokens from src/styles/common.ts, (2) inline styles in JSX that belong in a mirrored src/styles/ file, (3) useStudioStore.getState() called inside a render path (only allowed in event handlers/effects), (4) new global state created outside useStudioStore.ts, (5) missing JSDoc on exported functions or hooks, (6) any `any` type that should be `unknown`. Report only real violations with file:line references — do not flag code that is fine, and do not make edits unless asked.
